snippet.title: Shields of Loyalty | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Shields of Loyalty 1.0 is out now on Steam!
 Play today ➤https://store.steampowered.com/app/1318240/Shields_of_Loyalty/|

The time has come to reclaim Mantaria. Lead your army, shape your legend, and fight to restore order in this deeply tactical, high-replayability turn-based strategy game.

⚔️ Full dark fantasy campaign across the war-torn island of Mantaria
⚔️ 3 playable factions—each with unique units, auras, and strategies
⚔️ Face monstrous new mini bosses and elite enemies
⚔️ Create your own battlegrounds with custom map support

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q

#indiegames #turnbasedstrategy #strategy #fantasy #tactics  #steamgames
